title: hieracium triangulare subsp. lacerifolium
intro: Hieracium triangulare subsp. lacerifolium, commonly known as Rough Hawkweed, is a perennial plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae) that is native to the Mediterranean region. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium triangulare subsp. lacerifolium include wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes. The bioactive constituents of the plant are responsible for its medicinal properties, including its ability to inhibit the growth of microorganisms and reduce inflammation.
